Name: Corgi Agent Deck
Author: Andrii Klymiuk

Actions.Name: Session
Actions.Tooltip: One Claude Code session per key: press to focus its window, long-press to pin. Drop as many as you have keys.

Actions.Name: Talk
Actions.Tooltip: Dictate into the session in front: press to talk, press again to send. While that session waits on a permission the key turns red: press to allow, hold to deny. A terminal session needs /voice tap in Claude Code and the chord bound (default ctrl+y); the Claude Code panel takes cmd+d.

Actions.Name: Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: A canned prompt: press to type it into the session in front (continue, run the tests, /compact, commit, or your own text), with Enter unless turned off.

Actions.Name: Budget
Actions.Tooltip: One Claude account's usage: a ring for the five-hour window, a bar for the seven-day one, and when it resets. Blue when a session under it hit the limit, red when the window will run out first. Press to open corgi's dashboard.

Description: Every Claude Code session on this Mac on its own key: working, needs you, done, with its context window along the bottom. Press to focus the window and terminal tab; long-press to pin. Talk, Prompt and Budget keys answer permissions, send canned prompts and show your usage. Powered by corgi agent.
